     \[
     I = \frac{\xi}{R}
     \]

     \[

     \]
   - The current density is along the axis of the cable, so:
     \[
     J = \frac{\xi}{R \pi a^2} \hat{z}
     \]

\]

Thus, the definite integral is:

\[
\boxed{9}.
\]

The work must be performed by the external force (lifting the piston) to raise the piston by \( P_a (n - 1) V_1 \).
